name: RtlAllocateHeap
why: Native CRT heap override (XBOX_NATIVE_HEAP). Replaces the recompiled MSVC allocator; the recompiled body stays linked as __real_ so the A/B toggle is real.

name: RtlFreeHeap
why: Pairs with RtlAllocateHeap: a pointer from the native arena must not reach the recompiled free path.

name: RtlReAllocateHeap
why: Closes C057: without it the CRT's realloc reads a native-arena block header as its own and corrupts it.

name: memcpy
why: Observer only (listscan): reports any copy whose length is implausible, which is how the list tail-shift underflow was measured. Delegates to the recompiled body.

name: list_find_by_name
why: Observer only (listscan): reports the name, count and returned index of each lookup. Delegates to the recompiled body.

name: list_remove_shift
why: Observer only (listscan), and the SELF-TEST for isolation: its caller sub_00289F50 shares a generated chunk with it, so before --isolate existed this wrapper measurably never fired (issue #4). If it reports 0 calls on a run that reaches the ARK symbol table, isolation has regressed.
